description: The repository convention (integer cents, never a float) contradicts the obvious implementation. Pins that CLAUDE.md is read and followed, which is what the regression gate protects when CLAUDE.md changes.
title: Add a percentage fee to the ledger
prompt: Add a method `Fee(percent int) int64` to Account in ledger.go returning the fee on the current balance for a whole-percent rate, rounded down to the cent. Add a test for it covering 0%, 10% on 1000 cents, and 3% on 1001 cents. Do not change ledger_test.go's existing tests.
